title: Lofted shell and kernel assembly
summary: A hollow elliptical loft with a 1.5 mm floor, plus a separate 5 mm box constructed through direct OpenCascade. Dimensions are millimeters.
script:
from OCP.BRepPrimAPI import BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox
from OCP.gp import gp_Pnt

# Four analytic quadrants keep each elliptical loft boundary well conditioned.
def ellipse_profile(x_radius, y_radius, z):
    return cq.Wire.assembleEdges([
        cq.Edge.makeEllipse(x_radius, y_radius, (0, 0, z),
                            angle1=90*i, angle2=90*(i+1))
        for i in range(4)
    ])

outer = cq.Solid.makeLoft([ellipse_profile(20, 12, 0),
                         ellipse_profile(16, 10, 8)])
# A second loft cuts the cavity and leaves a 1.5 mm floor.
cavity = cq.Solid.makeLoft([ellipse_profile(17.75, 10.125, 1.5),
                          ellipse_profile(14, 8.25, 9)])
body = outer.cut(cavity)

# A second positioned part created directly with the OpenCascade bindings.
kernel_box = cq.Shape.cast(BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox(gp_Pnt(35, 0, 0), 5, 5, 5).Shape())
result = cq.Assembly().add(body, name='lofted_shell').add(kernel_box, name='kernel_box')
